items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And these guys really inspired us, and Godley used to flip his sticks

ctx.x: Keg, Keg Johnson, yes. So I told my mother, I said, "I want to play drums," because there was a couple of drummers around, you know, like I had seen A. Godley G. Gottlieb with Alphonso Trent's orchestra, and then that was a very good drummer that went to school. He was my brother's age, maybe a little bit older, named John R. Davis, which was a terrific drummer, and there was another fine drummer named John Humphries, John Humphries used to play with Troy Floyd.
John R. Davis -- These are bands, : He's a Texas man.
